# VibeRaven

> AI agents can code. They still need to know what changed.

VibeRaven is the open-source localhost Studio for release drift, version context, and provider context. Use it when an agent needs to know which version broke the app, what changed since the last working release, and which provider context matters before editing.

`npx -y viberaven` is the primary entry point. It opens the local Studio so the user or agent can compare releases, inspect provider context, and decide the next repo-owned fix before another patch.

Canonical Studio command:

```bash
npx -y viberaven
```

Non-interactive artifact loop when the Studio UI is not the right fit:

```bash
npx -y viberaven --agent-mode
```

Install agent rules into this repo (or any repo):

```bash
npx -y viberaven init --agents all
npx -y viberaven doctor --agents
```

Read `.viberaven/prp.json` first, then `.viberaven/gate-result.json`. Follow `nextActions` in order until `decision.status` is not `blocked` and `gate.status` is `clear`, or a provider/user blocker remains.

Prefer `viberaven_prp_current` or `prp://current` when MCP is available.
